purpose: Openly licensed/public-domain nature and satellite images for segmentation/font-shape experiments. These are source fixtures only; no ground-truth masks are claimed or fabricated.
method_summary: Searched with Firecrawl and saved search outputs under .firecrawl/.
Collected licensing/provenance from Wikimedia Commons pages and Commons API extmetadata.
Scraped source pages with Firecrawl and retained evidence files under .firecrawl/.
Downloaded images only to ignored output/nature-source-images/.
Created temporary downscaled review previews under .firecrawl/nature-review-previews/ and inspected them with view_image.
global_rights_caveats: Not legal advice; re-check license/source pages before external redistribution.
CC BY-SA 3.0 fixture requires attribution and share-alike for adapted/redistributed derivatives.
CC0 fixtures are public-domain dedications, but provenance is retained for auditability.

NASA/USGS fixtures are marked public domain by Commons and supported by official NASA media-usage guidance; NASA still restricts logos/identifiers, prohibits implied endorsement, and warns that third-party material on NASA sites may be separately copyrighted.
No ground-truth segmentation masks exist in this manifest; rectangles and keep/avoid points are visual-review proposals only.

images.experiment_role: isolated leaf on clean background; baseline foreground segmentation fixture
images.title: Autumn Silver Maple Leaf

license.rights_note: Attribution and share-alike apply if distributing modified/adapted versions or derivative annotation artifacts.

visual_review.observed_content: Red/orange scanned silver maple leaf on white background, including thin stem and jagged lobes.
visual_review.desired_glyph_shape: single maple-leaf silhouette for A/M/star-like ornamental glyph tests
visual_review.suitability_notes: High-contrast clean background makes it a good first sanity check for edge fidelity and stem retention.

images.experiment_role: leaf on clutter; hard negative background fixture
images.title: Top view of brown leaf litter (Unsplash)

license.usage_terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication
license.rights_note: Commons records this as pre-2017 Unsplash CC0; keep the Commons page and Wayback evidence with any redistribution.

visual_review.observed_content: Overhead wet autumn leaf litter with many overlapping dark leaves; one pale maple leaf is prominent near the center.
visual_review.proposed_target: central pale maple leaf only; use surrounding leaves as clutter/background
visual_review.desired_glyph_shape: clutter-extracted small maple silhouette for robustness tests
visual_review.suitability_notes: Good for testing whether prompts/crops can isolate one leaf when colors and shapes repeat across the background.

images.experiment_role: whole plant/branch; connected leaves, twig, and acorn fixture
images.title: Small oak branch

license.usage_terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication
license.rights_note: CC0 dedication; attribution not required but origin/author retained for provenance.

visual_review.observed_content: Small northern red oak branch on soil/clutter, with multiple connected green leaves, twig, and one acorn.
visual_review.proposed_target: main green oak branch cluster including twig and acorn
visual_review.desired_glyph_shape: branchy K/Y-like ornamental glyph with leaf lobes and a small acorn dot
visual_review.suitability_notes: Useful for multi-part foreground connectivity and thin twig retention against textured ground.

images.experiment_role: fern/needle-like thin structure; delicate tendril fixture
images.title: Close-up of Emerging Fern Frond in Spring

license.usage_terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication
license.rights_note: CC0 dedication; attribution not required but origin/author retained for provenance.

visual_review.observed_content: Emerging fern frond and tendrils beside a vertical trunk/stem, with shallow-focus dark green background.
visual_review.proposed_target: thin green fern shoot/frond; treat large trunk as distractor unless testing combined plant segmentation
visual_review.desired_glyph_shape: curled C/S swash or thin-stroke fern ornament
visual_review.suitability_notes: Good stress case for retaining thin stems and fuzzy margins while avoiding an adjacent high-contrast trunk.

images.experiment_role: satellite meandering river; high-resolution sinuous water fixture
images.title: Meandering Mississippi (5182095595)

license.rights_note: Commons marks this NASA/USGS/Landsat image public domain; NASA policy still asks for source acknowledgment and no implied endorsement.

visual_review.observed_content: False-color Landsat view of Mississippi River meanders, oxbows, fields, and towns; turquoise water contrasts with orange/brown land.
visual_review.proposed_target: main turquoise Mississippi channel plus major oxbow water bodies
visual_review.desired_glyph_shape: large S/G-like river stroke with loops and counters
visual_review.suitability_notes: Excellent for color-separated water extraction and curve simplification into glyph strokes; not a natural-color scene.

images.experiment_role: satellite braided river; thin branching channel fixture
images.title: Braided River in Tibet Redraws Its Channels (154747)
images.author_or_creator: NASA Earth Observatory image by Michala Garrison and animations by Ross Walter, using Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey
images.credit_line: NASA Earth Observatory image by Michala Garrison and animations by Ross Walter, using Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey

license.rights_note: Public-domain NASA/USGS evidence is from Commons plus the official NASA Earth Observatory page; avoid logo/endorsement uses.

visual_review.observed_content: Landsat view of Yarlung Zangbo River with dark blue braided channels crossing a mountainous tan/green scene; label and scale bar present.
visual_review.proposed_target: dark braided river band; avoid text label and scale bar when deriving masks
visual_review.desired_glyph_shape: thin branching horizontal stroke, useful for E/F crossbar or waveform-like ornament
visual_review.suitability_notes: Low-resolution but valuable as a braided-channel topology stress test; embedded label makes it unsuitable for fully automatic masks without cropping.

images.experiment_role: satellite river delta/estuary; lake-delta water/ice fixture
images.title: A Delta Oasis in Southeastern Kazakhstan
images.author_or_creator: NASA Earth Observatory images by Joshua Stevens, using Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey
images.credit_line: NASA Earth Observatory images by Joshua Stevens, using Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey

license.rights_note: Public-domain NASA/USGS source; scene includes ice and water, so define the foreground class before making a mask.

visual_review.observed_content: Natural-color Landsat view of Ili River Delta/Lake Balkhash with blue water, ice sheets, islands, and desert wetlands.
visual_review.proposed_target: blue/turquoise water-and-ice mass forming the delta/lake shape
visual_review.desired_glyph_shape: rounded O/Q-like basin with broken counters/island holes
visual_review.suitability_notes: Good for broad area segmentation and hole preservation; water/ice boundary may need semantic decision before mask labeling.

images.experiment_role: satellite delta/sediment plume; cloud-like water boundary fixture
images.title: Mackenzie river enters Beaufort sea
images.author_or_creator: NASA Earth Observatory images by Jesse Allen, using Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey
images.credit_line: NASA Earth Observatory images by Jesse Allen, using Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey

license.rights_note: Public-domain NASA/USGS source per Commons; NASA no-endorsement and third-party-material caveats still apply.

visual_review.observed_content: High-resolution Landsat view of Mackenzie Delta, sediment plumes in the Beaufort Sea, islands, channels, and shoreline wetlands.
visual_review.proposed_target: milky sediment plume plus visible delta channels; choose water/plume foreground for cloud-letter experiments
visual_review.desired_glyph_shape: soft cloud/C-shape or delta fan with branching counters
visual_review.suitability_notes: Large, detailed image for plume/shoreline simplification; semantic foreground must be defined because water, sediment, and land intermix.

excluded_or_not_done: No repo implementation changes outside docs/research/nature-source-manifest.json and ignored output/.firecrawl artifacts.
